hero.title: Travel, planned around
hero.lead: We are a small travel agency that builds clear routes so you spend less time arranging and more time somewhere new.

story.title: Born from missed connections
paragraphs: Lunavia started when our founders kept fixing trips that looked perfect on paper and fell apart in airports. We rebuilt the process around transparent timing, trusted local partners, and a specialist who actually answers the phone.
Today we design custom itineraries and curated packages for people who want the world without the spreadsheet.
story.imageAlt: Traveler with a backpack overlooking a city

valuesIntro.title: The Lunavia way
valuesIntro.lead: Every trip follows the same promise: honest routes, human support, and logistics that stay out of your way.

values.title: Honest routes
values.text: We plan around real connections, local partners, and time you will actually enjoy — not brochure filler.

values.title: Human support
values.text: One travel specialist stays with your trip from the first idea to the flight home.

values.title: Less logistics
values.text: Transfers, timing, and tickets are handled so your days stay open for living.

teamIntro.title: People behind your route
teamIntro.lead: Specialists who know destinations, airports, and the quiet details that turn a plan into a trip.

cta.title: Tell us where you want to go
cta.text: Share a destination, a season, or just a feeling — we will sketch a route that fits.
